title: Example: CI failure triage (bundled sample)
provenance: Constructed example modelled on a CI-triage agent session using an MCP GitHub server plus filesystem tools. Not a recording of real user traffic. All reported savings are computed from this content by the same analyzers Preloop runs on real sessions.
pricing_note: Priced at Claude Sonnet 4 public list rates.

messages.content:
You are a release engineering agent operating on the acme/checkout repository. Your job is to triage failing CI pipelines, identify the root cause, and report a concise summary to the on-call engineer.

Operating rules:
- Always inspect the most recent failing workflow run before forming a hypothesis.
- Prefer reading source files over guessing at behaviour.
- Never modify CI configuration without explicit human approval.
- When you have a root cause, state it in one sentence, then list the evidence you used.
The main branch CI has been red since this morning. Figure out what is failing and why, then summarise the root cause for the on-call engineer.

function.name: github__list_workflow_runs
function.description: List recent GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository, including status, conclusion, timing, triggering actor, and the head commit associated with each run. Supports filtering by branch and event.

status.description: Run status filter, e.g. completed or failure.

function.name: github__get_workflow_run_logs
function.description: Fetch the raw log output for a single GitHub Actions workflow run. Returns the concatenated step logs as plain text, which may be large for long-running or highly parallel pipelines.

function.name: fs__read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the local checkout and return its full contents. Use this to inspect source, configuration, and lockfiles before forming a hypothesis about a failure.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the file to read.

function.name: github__create_issue
function.description: Open a new GitHub issue in the target repository with a title, markdown body, assignees, labels, and an optional milestone. Use this to file a defect once a root cause has been confirmed by a human reviewer.

function.name: github__update_issue
function.description: Update an existing GitHub issue: change its title, body, state, labels, assignees, or milestone. Commonly used to close a triage issue once the underlying pipeline failure has been resolved.

state.description: New issue state, open or closed.

function.name: github__list_pull_requests
function.description: List open or closed pull requests for a repository including title, author, target branch, mergeability, review state, and the set of files each pull request touches.

function.name: github__merge_pull_request
function.description: Merge an approved pull request using the repository's configured merge strategy. Fails if required status checks have not passed or if the branch is behind its base.

merge_method.description: One of merge, squash, or rebase.

function.name: slack__post_message
function.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or thread on behalf of the agent, with optional blocks, attachments, and thread targeting. Used to notify the on-call engineer once triage has completed.

function.name: jira__create_ticket
function.description: Create a Jira ticket in the configured project with a summary, description, issue type, priority, and component assignment. Used when the team tracks defects in Jira rather than GitHub issues.

issue_type.description: Issue type, e.g. Bug or Task.

function.name: github__list_workflow_runs
function.description: List recent GitHub Actions workflow runs for a repository, including status, conclusion, timing, triggering actor, and the head commit associated with each run. Supports filtering by branch and event.

status.description: Run status filter, e.g. completed or failure.

function.name: github__get_workflow_run_logs
function.description: Fetch the raw log output for a single GitHub Actions workflow run. Returns the concatenated step logs as plain text, which may be large for long-running or highly parallel pipelines.

function.name: fs__read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the local checkout and return its full contents. Use this to inspect source, configuration, and lockfiles before forming a hypothesis about a failure.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the file to read.

function.name: github__create_issue
function.description: Open a new GitHub issue in the target repository with a title, markdown body, assignees, labels, and an optional milestone. Use this to file a defect once a root cause has been confirmed by a human reviewer.

function.name: github__update_issue
function.description: Update an existing GitHub issue: change its title, body, state, labels, assignees, or milestone. Commonly used to close a triage issue once the underlying pipeline failure has been resolved.

state.description: New issue state, open or closed.

function.name: github__list_pull_requests
function.description: List open or closed pull requests for a repository including title, author, target branch, mergeability, review state, and the set of files each pull request touches.

function.name: github__merge_pull_request
function.description: Merge an approved pull request using the repository's configured merge strategy. Fails if required status checks have not passed or if the branch is behind its base.

merge_method.description: One of merge, squash, or rebase.

function.name: slack__post_message
function.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or thread on behalf of the agent, with optional blocks, attachments, and thread targeting. Used to notify the on-call engineer once triage has completed.

function.name: jira__create_ticket
function.description: Create a Jira ticket in the configured project with a summary, description, issue type, priority, and component assignment. Used when the team tracks defects in Jira rather than GitHub issues.

issue_type.description: Issue type, e.g. Bug or Task.
